classification.difficultyReason: Reverse the side-naming definitions to select an acute reference angle: choose the vertex opposite a labelled opposite side or the acute endpoint of an adjacent leg, then name that angle.

content.prompt: Name the angle that has been used as the reference angle for the naming of the sides.

spec.description: Right-angled triangle LMN, with horizontal LM, vertical LN and opposite beside LN. Ordinary source blue strokes use house black.
spec.mathematics: Right angle at L; LN is labelled opposite.
spec.answerVisibility: No reference angle is marked or supplied.

answer.worked: The reference angle is opposite $LN$, so it is the angle at $M$: $\angle LMN$.

spec.description: Triangle BCD with horizontal BC, D below and between B and C, and adjacent beside DC. Ordinary source blue strokes use house black.
spec.mathematics: Right angle at D; DC is labelled adjacent.
spec.answerVisibility: No reference angle is marked or supplied.

answer.worked: $DC$ is adjacent to the reference angle. Its acute-angle endpoint is $C$, so the reference angle is $\angle BCD$.

spec.description: Triangle FGH with horizontal HG, F above and nearer H, and opposite beside FG. Ordinary source blue strokes use house black.
spec.mathematics: Right angle at F; FG is labelled opposite.
spec.answerVisibility: No reference angle is marked or supplied.

answer.worked: The reference angle is opposite $FG$, so it is the angle at $H$: $\angle FHG$.

spec.description: Triangle XYZ with vertical XZ, horizontal ZY and adjacent beside XZ. Ordinary source blue strokes use house black.
spec.mathematics: Right angle at Z; XZ is labelled adjacent.
spec.answerVisibility: No reference angle is marked or supplied.

answer.worked: $XZ$ is adjacent to the reference angle. Its acute-angle endpoint is $X$, so the reference angle is $\angle YXZ$.

spec.description: Triangle MNP with horizontal MN and P below and right of centre; opposite beside NP. Ordinary source blue strokes use house black.
spec.mathematics: Right angle at P; NP is labelled opposite.
spec.answerVisibility: No reference angle is marked or supplied.

answer.worked: The reference angle is opposite $NP$, so it is the angle at $M$: $\angle NMP$.

spec.description: Triangle RST with horizontal RS, T below and right of centre, hypotenuse above RS and adjacent beside ST. Ordinary source blue strokes use house black.
spec.mathematics: Right angle at T; RS is the hypotenuse and ST is labelled adjacent.
spec.answerVisibility: No reference angle is marked or supplied.

answer.worked: $RS$ is the hypotenuse. The labelled adjacent side $ST$ meets the reference angle at $S$, so the reference angle is $\angle RST$.
